source: runtime capture (SkyZH) 2026-09-10 花园实测; https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Terry (2026-09-03 更新); 交叉核对 https://hypixel-skyblock.fandom.com/wiki/Terry (一致)
note: Terry,Jerry 工坊冰钓小屋里的渔夫,开口就是「Ahoy」的水手腔;作为花园访客时抱怨自己吃冰没味道。Jerry 工坊那边的台词在 Events/NPC_Message/Terry.json。

messages.raw: §fAhoy, §b%s§f! People always tell me they like ice cream, but ice never really tastes like anything for me!
messages.text: Ahoy, %s! People always tell me they like ice cream, but ice never really tastes like anything for me!
messages.zh: 嘿哟,%s! 大伙儿都说喜欢吃冰淇淋,可冰在我嘴里从来就没什么味道!

segments.text: ! People always tell me they like ice cream, but ice never really tastes like anything for me!
segments.zh: ! 大伙儿都说喜欢吃冰淇淋,可冰在我嘴里从来就没什么味道!

messages.raw: §fYou are saying I need to combine these items with ice to have a taste? I'll believe it when I see it!
messages.text: You are saying I need to combine these items with ice to have a taste? I'll believe it when I see it!
messages.zh: 你是说把这些东西和冰掺在一起就有味道了? 眼见为实,我得亲自试试!

messages.text: I'll keep crunching on those ice cubes, maybe I am missing something.
messages.zh: 那我接着嚼我的冰块吧,说不定是我漏了什么门道。
